name: mode-variants-exec-flipped
why: `mode-variants` with one bit changed and nothing else: `src/app.ts` is executable here. Same paths, same blobs, same tree order — so the two goldens' digests differ if and only if the mode is really part of the hashed record. Making a script executable is a change a reviewer should see, and a digest that ignored the mode would call the two trees the same deliverable.
